opportunities.name: Hotel proposal: search Booking.com, convert price on XE, email the traveler
opportunities.description: For a given city and date range, search Booking.com, pick a hotel, convert its EUR price to the traveler's currency on XE, and email the traveler a proposal asking for approval to book.
opportunities.site: booking.com, xe.com, internal webmail compose page
steps: Open booking.com, dismiss the cookie and sign-in popups if they appear
Type the destination city and pick the first suggestion
Open the date picker, go to the check-in month and click the check-in and check-out dates
Click Search
Scroll the results and note the chosen hotel's name and total price in EUR
Open xe.com currency converter (Convert tab)
Set From to EUR and enter the hotel price as the amount
Open the To currency dropdown, search for the target currency and select it
Read the converted amount
Open the mail compose page, enter the recipient
Set Subject to 'Hotel for {city}, {checkin}-{checkout}'
Set Body to 'Hi {name}, proposed hotel: {hotel} , {price} EUR (about {converted} {currency}). OK to book?'
Send (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: Frankfurt, Nov 17-Nov 20; Vienna House by Wyndham Frankfurt South 818 EUR -> USD 915.34; maria@example.com
Milan, Dec 1-Dec 4; BB Hotels Aparthotel Visconti 264 EUR -> JPY 46,794; kenji@example.com
Amsterdam, Jan 12-Jan 15; Jan Luyken Amsterdam 577 EUR -> GBP 487.44; aisha@example.com (Zurich was typed at ~794s and then dropped)

opportunities.name: City heads-up email: weather forecast plus a BBC strike news check
opportunities.description: For a city and day of the week, look up the 10-day forecast on weather.com, search BBC News for '{city} strike', and email a colleague a heads-up with the forecast and the top headline.
opportunities.site: weather.com, bbc.com, internal webmail compose page
steps: Open weather.com and click the location selector
Type the city name and select the matching result
Open the '10 Day' tab and read the high/low and conditions for the target day
Open bbc.com, click search, type '{city} strike' and submit
Note the top result's headline and date
Open the mail compose page, enter the recipient
Set Subject to 'Heads-up: {city} on {day}'
Set Body to 'Hi {name}, {city} on {day}: {high}°/{low}°, {conditions}. Latest news: {headline} ({date}).'
Send (the user clicked Discard in the recording)

instances.values: Berlin, Saturday, 58°/44° Partly Cloudy; 'Students strike across Germany...'; raj@example.com
Madrid, Monday, 64°/50° Partly Cloudy; 'Villa eye Endrick loan deal...'; sofia@example.com
London, Thursday, 70°/56° Cloudy; 'School support staff strike over pay'; tom@example.com

opportunities.name: Traveler visa and holiday note
opportunities.description: For a traveler's nationality and destination country, read the visa requirement on Wikipedia, look up the destination's public holidays for the travel month on timeanddate.com, and add a summary line to Notes.
steps: On Wikipedia, search 'Visa requirements for {nationality} citizens' and open the article
Find the destination country's row and note the visa type and allowed stay
Open timeanddate.com Holidays, dismiss the consent dialog if it appears
Search for or select the destination country and open its holidays page
Read the public holidays in the travel month
Open the Notes page, type '{Nationality} traveler to {country}: {visa}, allowed stay {stay}. Holidays in {month}: {holidays}' in New note and press Enter

instances.values: Indian -> Japan: eVisa; December: no national public holidays, Dec 31 bank holiday
Brazilian -> Canada: visa required (eTA possible by air); November: Nov 11 Remembrance Day
Nigerian -> United Kingdom; May: May 4 Early May Bank Holiday, May 25 Spring Bank Holiday
